skill.name: Spring Boot 3.0 System Requirements Validation
skill.description: Verify that the application environment meets Spring Boot 3.0 minimum requirements before initiating upgrade. Checks that Java version is 17 or later and Spring Framework is 6.0 or later.
skill.skill_body:
Before upgrading to Spring Boot 3.0, validate the following prerequisites:
1. Check Java version is 17 or later (Java 8 is no longer supported)
2. Confirm Spring Framework version is 6.0 or later
3. Document findings and block upgrade if any requirement is unmet

## Objective

Prevent upgrade to Spring Boot 3.0 if system requirements are not met
## Applicable Signals

- Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.0 is planned
- Pre-upgrade validation phase initiated
- System environment assessment required

## Contraindications

- Application is already running on Spring Boot 3.0
- Environment validation has already been completed and passed

## Intervention Moves

- Check current Java version against 17+ requirement
- Verify Spring Framework version is 6.0+
- Document version mismatch if found
- Block upgrade and report incompatibility

## Workflow Steps

- Retrieve current Java version from runtime environment
- Retrieve current Spring Framework version from project configuration
- Compare Java version against minimum requirement of 17
- Compare Spring Framework version against minimum requirement of 6.0
- If all requirements met, return success confirmation
- If any requirement fails, document specific missing requirement and block upgrade

## Constraints

- Must be executed before any dependency or configuration changes
- Requires access to runtime environment and project configuration
- Java 8 is explicitly not supported; upgrade is mandatory

## Cautions

- Do not proceed with upgrade if Java version is below 17
- Do not proceed if Spring Framework version is below 6.0
- Verify all transitive dependencies support Java 17+ before upgrade

## Output Contract

- Boolean confirmation that Java version is 17+, Spring Framework is 6.0+, and all system requirements are met. If any requirement fails, return failure status with specific missing requirement details and block upgrade.
